title: GANTZ
description: Knowing that he is risking his life, Kei Kurono makes the uncharacteristic decision to jump onto train tracks to save a homeless man from death, only to perish in the process. But when he comes to, Kei finds himself in a room with several other recently deceased people, as well as a large, mysterious black ball. While the people in the room are trying to make sense of their situation, the ball suddenly opens, revealing a cache of weapons and strange black suits. The ball then instructs everyone that they have to hunt down an alien and teleports them to an unknown location.With very little information to work off of, Kei teams up with his childhood friend Masaru Katou and an unfamiliar woman, and the trio explore their new surroundings. It quickly becomes apparent, however, that they have stumbled into a dark and dangerous world where anything could happen to them.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After Kei and his childhood friend, Kato, are torn into bloody pieces by a speeding train, they awake in an unfamiliar room, surrounded by strangers. In the middle of the room is a bizarre black sphere: the Gantz.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The scores are tallied and Nishi explains some of what he knows about the rules of the strange world of the Gantz. The unusual situation grows even odder the next day when Kei wakes—and finds that this nightmare is no dream.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Seemingly back among the living, Kato must protect his brother from their hateful aunt. Meanwhile, Kei’s special suit gives him an advantage against the bullies at school. But will it help him when Kishimoto appears at his door?

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Despite his best efforts, Kei remains unsatisfied during Kishimoto’s overnight stay at his apartment. At the place Kato calls home, more ugly evidence of abuse piles up.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Kato’s patience is being tested. At home, the abuse dished out by his aunt pushes him to the breaking point. Meanwhile, at school, a group of bullies forces him to take decisive and drastic action.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: A new round begins for the gang. Appearing before the Gantz, they find themselves joined by a diverse group of fresh players. As the game gets underway, Kei panics when he realizes his suit is nowhere to be found.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: As the group prepares to track down the Suzuki alien, Tetsu’s gang is creating conflict and Nishi’s smart mouth isn’t helping the situation. When tensions boil over, blood is spilled before the hunt even begins.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kato is forced to take action to save Nishi from certain death, but he may not be ruthless enough to kill the Suzuki alien. Time is running out for yet another player trapped in the cruel world of the Gantz.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The group is beginning to figure out the rules of the twisted game in which they are caught, but survival is still far from guaranteed as the battle with the remaining Suzuki aliens erupts.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kei, suitless and outnumbered by the Suzuki aliens, must face the biggest monster alone. When the battle ends and the scores are tallied, the group sees that there might be a way to escape their strange fate.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Change is in the air for the players of the deadly game. Fed up with his aunt, Kato finds a new place to live with his little brother. Meanwhile, Kei’s attitude pushes Kishimoto away, and Tetsu’s life spirals brutally out of control.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The Gantz calls the players for another round. Among the new faces gathered before the sphere: a television evangelist that thinks he has all the answers and a girl who seems willing to give Kei the attention he seeks.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: When Kato shares what he knows in an effort to help the new players, the evangelist begins to think something sinister is afoot. The holy man learns just how correct he is as the game’s new targets make their presence known.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The team’s efforts to defeat the giant aliens are hindered by two thugs who are brutally tormenting a homeless man - the very same homeless man that Kei and Kato encountered just before their deaths.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Kei goes on a rampage, leading the battle against the giant aliens. Yet another unhappy surprise awaits the team.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: After claiming victory against the giant red and green aliens, the group boldly rushes into battle against the smaller statues. Soon enough, they find their numbers thinned by an enormous new enemy.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Several players meet with gruesome ends as the living statues continue their onslaught. Tragically, one of the mutilated victims is someone very dear to Kato and Kei.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The carnage continues and truly no one is safe. As wounded Kei struggles to stay alive, his teammates fall one after the other. When the final foe is defeated, only one player will be around to see the score.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kei returns to the Gantz and finds many familiar faces will be joining him in battle. Unfortunately, Kei is shocked to see that their alien prey wears a familiar face as well.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: With no explanation, the Gantz has chosen Kei to be hunted. At first, the rest of the players are unsure of what they should do - but the black sphere soon helps them decide that Kei should die.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The new players are beginning to see just how dangerous the two bum-killing freaks really are. As the situation escalates, the members of the team look to the one person who might be able to help them survive - Kei.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Madness is taking over as the team hunts the two brutal maniacs in their midst. The number of fatalities grows quickly, and Kei begins to understand that the Gantz might not be his worst problem.

episodes_data.title: GANTZ Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Facing his deadliest foe, Kei is forced to question everything he’s learned—and all that he has lost—in the twisted world of the Gantz. No matter if he lives or dies, for Kei, the game now ends.
